Subject: Service disruption on 2026-12-11 — request for reconciliation

Hi Markus,

- Whether this incident is eligible for SLA credit per Redwood’s terms

I've copied our support alias in case you need additional logs.

From: marcus_lin@redwood.ai
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-13T15:30:00Z
Subject: RE: Service disruption on 2026-12-11 — internal validation

Folks — I validated the incident window against our internal telemetry and the public incident postmortem (ops link: https://docs.redwood.ai/ops/incidents/PS-2026-091). Summary:
- Observed degraded serving from 2026-12-11T01:19:37Z — 2026-12-11T05:07:58Z (3h 48m 21s) after retry backoff; impact on generation endpoints and streaming.
- No scheduled maintenance during that window.
- We saw 22% increase in tail latency and ~18% request errors for Poolside's routed requests during the window.

Per our SLA (99.95% monthly uptime), the outage math for a 30-day month:
- Total monthly minutes = 43,200
- Allowed downtime (0.05%) = 21.6 minutes
- Measured downtime = 228 minutes (3h 48m)
- Excess downtime = 206.4 minutes

SLA severity bands:
- < 60 minutes excess = 5% credit
- 60–480 minutes = 10% credit
- >480 minutes = 25% credit

Conclusion: Poolside falls into the 10% credit band. I attached the raw logs we used (poolside-usage-logs-20261211.zip).

Marcus
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: poolside-usage-logs-20261211.zip (ZIP, 2.1MB)]

Subject: SLA credit breakdown and issuance options — Poolside Systems (PS-2026-091)

Hi Oliver — following Marcus’s validation and our billing review, here’s the proposed reconciliation for December 2026:

Summary:
- Affected billing period: 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-31
- Monthly invoice (net): $48,750.00
- Credit band (per SLA): 10% (60–480 min excess downtime)
- Proposed credit: $4,875.00 (10% of monthly net)

Issuance options (choose one):
A) Apply a one-time invoice adjustment to the Dec invoice (preferred) — we’ll issue a credit memo and reduce the invoice by $4,875.00.
B) Apply the amount as an account-level credit to be consumed against future usage (expires 12 months from issuance).
C) If you prefer a percentage-only confirmation for internal reporting, we can confirm a 10% SLA credit instead of dollar amounts.

Next steps for quick issuance: please reply to confirm option A or B and include the billing contact if different from this thread. Once we have confirmation we’ll:
- Generate a credit memo and DocuSign acknowledgement link (if Poolside requires a signed acceptance)
- Record the credit in HubSpot and mark the ticket resolved

Attached is a breakdown PDF (ps-credit-breakdown-20261215.pdf) with the calculation and links to the logs.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Billing Manager
